# langtools tests that cannot pass on DragonFly's HAMMER2 file system.
#
# bsd-tier1-in-vm.sh passes this list to jtreg for the langtools part on
# DragonFly, in the format of the repositories' own ProblemLists.
#
# T6394683 makes its newer file by opening an existing, empty B.class for
# writing (FileOutputStream, O_TRUNC) and closing it without a byte, once
# a second, until File.lastModified() says it is newer than B.java.  POSIX
# has open(O_TRUNC) of an existing file mark the modification time for
# update; HAMMER2 leaves it alone when the file is empty already, so the
# test gives up with "Cannot create files" after four seconds.  Measured
# in run #31: a file rewritten with data moved on a second at a time, an
# empty one truncated again a second later kept its time.

tools/javac/6394683/T6394683.java	6394683	generic-all	HAMMER2 keeps mtime on O_TRUNC of an empty file
